baseline.note: Isolated weighted-search reconstruction retains uncommitted threat-weighted scoring and Play! Pokemon data. All five original seed-20 teams and fitness scores reproduced exactly before expansion to seeds 7 and 42.

measurementNotes: Population 8 and 3 generations per run. Identical seeds and data; evaluation costs are reported rather than assumed equal.
matchupCalls counts calls into getMatchupResult and getShieldScenarioMatchupResult, including repeated queries served by downstream caches. These are not engine simulations or unique matrix cells.

elapsedMs covers generation, excluding sensitivity/ablation/held-out evaluation. RSS is cumulative process residency at report capture, after validation for the current search; it is not per-generation peak memory or a fair isolated memory comparison.
Tail .25, band .025, viability .5, and scenario counts 8/16/8 were fixed before held-out composition evaluation. No policy changed based on held-out scores.

Evolutionary objective omission does not omit that objective from mutation or final selection. Separate fixed-bank finalist ablations remove it from final ordering. Compare each to the full-policy winner from the same candidate bank, not automatically the runtime winner.
Full-field coverage is shared by selection and held-out stages; only composition families are held out.
